_doc: The Tern's bot crew (openspec/changes/crew-npcs, design 1 and 7; read by sc-core::crew::CompanyData). Departments in the order bots leave as players join (the last first). `count` is with one player aboard; `rooms` are layout compartment ids the department works in; a bot walks between places in them and stays at each for a time drawn from `stay_s`. `colour_srgb` is the tunic (sRGB 0-1), also the department's marker on the map (ship-plan-view).
